# Copilot Agents

This folder contains workspace-specific Copilot agent definitions for the Compliance_Agentic_AI_Design repo.

## Compliance Agent

- File: [compliance-agent.agent.md](compliance-agent.agent.md)
- Purpose: a named agent mode for the FastAPI compliance app, deterministic rule evaluation, incident review workflow, audit history, and related tests and docs.
- Scope: workspace-local, intended for this repository only.

Use this folder when you want to discover or update the agent definition that guides Copilot on this project.
